translations.web: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.
translations.bsb: So I thought: ‘I will die in my nest and multiply my days as the sand.
translations.kjv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
translations.asv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, And I shall multiply my days as the sand:
